description: This file implements the core logic for 'git config' commands, including listing, getting, setting, unsetting, renaming sections, removing sections, editing, and other configuration operations. It defines usage strings, options parsing, and functions to manipulate Git configuration files.

methods.name: option_parse_type
methods.description: Parses and sets the type of a configuration value based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: check_argc
methods.description: Checks if the argument count is within expected bounds.

methods.name: show_config_origin
methods.description: Displays the origin of a configuration key-value pair.

methods.name: show_config_scope
methods.description: Displays the scope of a configuration key-value pair.

methods.name: show_all_config
methods.description: Outputs all configuration key-value pairs with optional origin and scope info.

methods.name: format_config
methods.description: Formats a configuration key-value pair into a string buffer.

methods.name: collect_config
methods.description: Collects configuration entries matching certain criteria.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values based on key, pattern, and flags.

methods.name: normalize_value
methods.description: Normalizes a value based on its type for storage.

methods.name: git_get_color_config
methods.description: Retrieves color configuration value.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Gets a color configuration value, with optional default.

methods.name: git_get_colorbool_config
methods.description: Retrieves boolean color configuration.

methods.name: get_colorbool
methods.description: Gets a boolean color configuration value.

methods.name: check_write
methods.description: Checks if configuration can be written to the source.

methods.name: urlmatch_collect_fn
methods.description: Collects URL match configuration entries.

methods.name: get_urlmatch
methods.description: Retrieves configuration specific to a URL.

methods.name: default_user_config
methods.description: Generates default user config content.

methods.name: location_options_init
methods.description: Initializes configuration location options based on environment and flags.

methods.name: location_options_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with location options.

methods.name: display_options_init
methods.description: Initializes display options for configuration output.

methods.description: Handles 'git config list' command.

methods.description: Handles 'git config get' command.

methods.name: cmd_config_unset
methods.description: Handles 'git config unset' command.

methods.name: cmd_config_rename_section
methods.description: Handles 'git config rename-section' command.

methods.name: cmd_config_remove_section
methods.description: Handles 'git config remove-section' command.

methods.name: show_editor
methods.description: Opens the configuration file in an editor.

methods.name: cmd_config_edit
methods.description: Handles 'git config edit' command.

methods.description: Handles various 'git config' subcommands based on action flags.
